title: Equality, Equity, and Causality in Fairness Research: A Commentary on Cheng (2026)
abstract: arXiv:2607.17679v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This is an invited commentary on the Psychometrika focus article "Fairness Issues and Evaluation in Psychometrics and AI/ML: What Can We Learn from Each Field?" by Ying Cheng (2026, doi:10.1017/psy.2026.10110). Cheng offers a systematic comparison between long-standing test fairness and modern algorithmic fairness. Her mapping of the entire testing workflow onto the AI/ML fairness paradigm, rather than only the final selection stage, is a crucial contribution to interdisciplinary fairness research. This commentary extends her discussion by examining two conceptual issues: the distinction between equality and equity, and the role of causality in fairness research. The focus article and this commentary point to directions for future fairness research across the psychometrics and AI/ML communities.

translated_title: 公平性研究中的平等、公平与因果性：对Cheng（2026）的评论
translated_abstract: 这是一篇受邀撰写的评论，针对《心理测量学》重点文章《心理测量学与AI/ML中的公平性问题与评估：我们能从彼此领域学到什么？》（作者Ying Cheng，2026）。Cheng对长期存在的测验公平性与现代算法公平性进行了系统性比较。她将整个测验工作流程（而不仅仅是最终的选拔阶段）映射到AI/ML公平性范式上，这是对跨学科公平性研究的一项重要贡献。本评论通过探讨两个概念性问题来扩展她的讨论：平等与公平之间的区别，以及因果性在公平性研究中的作用。这篇重点文章和本评论共同为心理测量学界与AI/ML学界未来的公平性研究指明了方向。
tldr: 该评论在Cheng（2026）对心理测量学与AI/ML公平性系统比较的基础上，进一步探讨了平等与公平的概念区别以及因果性在公平性研究中的作用，为跨学科公平性研究的未来方向提供了指引。
en_tdlr: This commentary extends Cheng's (2026) systematic comparison between test fairness and algorithmic fairness by examining the equality-equity distinction and the role of causality in fairness research, pointing to future directions for interdisciplinary fairness research.
